annotations.title: Find an Advisor Who Centers Women Clients

description: Lists advisor-search networks (NAPFA, XY Planning Network, Garrett Planning Network, CFP Board) and a short list of fee-only firms that publicly state a focus on women clients or gender-lens investing, each with the public statement it is based on. A discovery list, not a recommendation. Without an active plugin subscription, returns the networks and firm names only; with one, adds the verification details and citations.
name: advisors.women_focused_directory
title: Find an Advisor Who Centers Women Clients
